eef_conventions.tool_definition: Same virtual L_ee/R_ee frame as Quest IK: wrist_yaw + 0.05 m local X; not a calibrated Dex1 fingertip/TCP
eef_conventions.quaternion: unit wxyz; first nonzero component positive
eef_conventions.observation: FK of pre-command measured arm and waist positions
eef_conventions.action: FK of submitted arm targets with the same measured waist positions
eef_conventions.delta_translation: target minus measured position, expressed in pelvis frame
eef_conventions.delta_rotation: q_target * inverse(q_measured), Hamilton product, pelvis frame
eef_conventions.delta_gripper: absolute submitted target in native motor position units

validation: All selected real-session pose features finite; no real episode exported or outcome assigned
